forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.description: Enter the e-mail address of your account: we send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.tooMany: Too many requests. Try again in a few minutes.
forgot.successMessage: If this address belongs to an account of this panel and was confirmed, a link to choose a new password has just been sent to it. It is valid for 30 minutes.
forgot.ssoHint: Accounts that sign in through Obligate (SSO) change their password in Obligate.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.description: At least {{count}} characters. Every open session of the account will be closed.
reset.failed: The password could not be changed.
reset.invalidToken: This link is invalid, has expired or was already used.
reset.successMessage: Sign in with your new password. Every session that was open has been closed; two-factor authentication is still asked.

confirmEmail.title: Confirm your e-mail address
confirmEmail.description: Confirm that this address belongs to you: the panel will send the e-mails of your account to it, password reset links included.
confirmEmail.invalid: This link is invalid, has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one from your profile.
confirmEmail.taken: This address is now used by another account.
confirmEmail.failed: The address could not be confirmed. Try again later.

email.unverifiedHint: No password reset link is sent to an unconfirmed address.
email.hint: Used for notifications and password recovery (once confirmed).
email.pendingChange: Waiting for the confirmation of {{email}}: open the link sent to it.
email.pendingVerify: Open the link sent to this address to confirm it.
email.failed: The address could not be changed.
email.taken: This e-mail address is already used by another account.
email.mailFailed: The confirmation e-mail could not be sent. Try again later.
email.tooSoon: A link was just sent: wait a moment before asking again.
email.modalHint: A link is sent to the new address: the change takes effect once it is opened. Your current address is told. Your password or a code of your authenticator is asked first.
email.modalHintNoMail: The platform cannot send e-mails yet: the new address is saved but stays unconfirmed (no password reset link is sent to it).

recovery.title: Recovery codes
recovery.failed: Failed to generate the recovery codes
recovery.none: No recovery codes yet: generate them and keep them safe, they sign you in if you lose your authenticator.
recovery.hint: Each code signs you in once instead of an authenticator code. Generating new codes cancels the previous ones.
recovery.modalHint: Keep them somewhere safe (a password manager). Each code signs you in once if you lose your authenticator. They are shown only now; generating new codes cancels these.
recovery.copyFailed: Copy failed: select the codes and copy them by hand
recovery.fileHeader: Oblimint recovery codes ({{host}}): each code works once.
recovery.useCode: Lost your authenticator? Use a recovery code
recovery.loginDescription: Enter one of the recovery codes you saved when you set up two-factor authentication. Each code works once.
recovery.invalidCode: Invalid or already used recovery code.
recovery.loginBanner: You signed in with a recovery code. If you lost your authenticator, disable it and set up a new one now: for 15 minutes no authenticator code is asked for this.
